description: Search past public auction results for compact market context. Return at most 6 sold lots per query. Use this only as research evidence, not as a final appraisal or formal value conclusion. This tool is read-only and returns no customer data.

keyword.description: Short auction search phrase such as Tiffany favrile vase or 19th century mahogany chest.

limit.description: Maximum number of comparable results, capped at 6.

name: search_auction_comparables
title: Search Auction Comparables
